framework_version: PPPFA-2000 + Preferential Procurement Regulations 2022 + PFMA/MFMA (PPA 2024 signed, not yet proclaimed)
note: RE-REVIEW when the Public Procurement Act 28 of 2024 is proclaimed. Per s66 PPA, bids advertised before commencement are governed by the law in force at advertisement.
disclaimer: Automated guidance only — NOT legal advice. Verify every item against the official tender documents and current legislation. Corpus requires sign-off by a procurement lawyer before production use.

rules.suggested_action: State a clear closing date and time.

rules.message: Closing date has no time of day.
rules.suggested_action: Confirm the exact closing time — late submissions are rejected.

rules.message: The briefing date falls on or after the closing date.
The closing date is on or before the publication date.
rules.suggested_action: Correct the timeline with the issuer.

rules.message: The advertising window looks short for a competitive bid.
rules.suggested_action: Extend the advertising period to the minimum for this procurement type.

rules.message: A compulsory briefing was required and its date has passed.
rules.suggested_action: Re-advertise or extend; bids are normally disqualified without attendance.

rules.message: This tender was extended or amended after publication.
rules.suggested_action: Disclose the reason and the authority for the deviation/extension.

rules.message: Construction-type work with no CIDB grading stated.
rules.suggested_action: State the required CIDB grade and class.

rules.message: Construction/works tender with no attached specification or BOQ.
rules.suggested_action: Attach the technical specification / bill of quantities.

rules.message: No preference point system (80/20 or 90/10) is stated.
rules.suggested_action: State the applicable preference point system.

rules.rule_ref: PPR 2022 (80/20 up to R50m; 90/10 above R50m)
rules.message: The stated preference system appears inconsistent with the contract value threshold.
rules.suggested_action: Align the system with the value threshold.

rules.message: No contact name, email or phone is provided.
rules.suggested_action: Provide the SCM contact for clarification questions.

rules.message: No estimated contract value is stated.
rules.suggested_action: Estimate from scope or prior similar awards before committing bid costs.

rules.message: The contract value is far from comparable tenders.
The advertising window is much shorter than comparable tenders.
rules.suggested_action: Consider extending to match comparable tenders.
